subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Is the detailed v2026.7.1 trace sufficient to sponsor a shared native-chat fix now, or should the reporter first attach the offered screenshots and timestamped history-response trace for a deterministic replay fixture?
rationale: The report strongly establishes a client-only failure, but several intertwined reconciliation invariants make an automated patch unsafe until the owning reviewer accepts the available proof boundary.

options.title: Request replay artifacts
options.body: Ask for the offered screenshots plus redacted request/response timing and payload identity data, then encode that sequence in the shared ChatViewModel test harness before changing behavior.

options.title: Sponsor source-led fix
options.body: Accept the current trace as sufficient and have the native-chat owner implement and device-verify a bounded reconciliation fix with delayed overlapping-history coverage.

recommendation.title: Request replay artifacts
recommendation.body: Ask for the offered screenshots plus redacted request/response timing and payload identity data, then encode that sequence in the shared ChatViewModel test harness before changing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the prior shipped iOS reconciliation work and were explicitly routed into this issue's discussion.
